title: PowerAndInfrastructureCatalogEntry
description: Standardized schema for telecom racks, UPS systems, external battery packs, and PDUs in NetSelect Enterprise

rackUnits.description: Vertical space occupied or provided in Rack Units (e.g. 1U, 2U, 42U)

watts.description: UPS real continuous power capacity in Watts (e.g. 1350, 1980, 2700)

inputVoltage.description: Nominal facility input voltage (DRC Rule 8B flags voltage mismatches between UPS and PDU)

inputPlug.description: AC utility plug type (e.g. 'NEMA 5-15P', 'NEMA 5-20P', 'NEMA L5-30P', 'NEMA L6-30P'). DRC Rule 8A mandates dedicated 30A branch circuit for 30A plugs.

outputReceptacles.description: Available output receptacles (e.g. '(6) 5-20R, (1) L5-30R', '(8) C13, (2) C19')

batteryChemistry.description: VRLA is hazardous in unventilated NEMA boxes per DRC Rule 7; LiFePO4 or DC-UPS required

outlets.description: PDU output receptacle count (DRC Rule 8C checks against active power cords)

circuit.description: Power feed circuit designation (e.g. 'Circuit A / UPS A', 'Circuit B / UPS B' per DRC Rule 14)
